name: com.vrsys.recording
description: Recording and replay of networked VRSYS sessions (transforms, audio and generic data tracks).

samples.description: Local and networked recording test scenes covering transforms, active state, hierarchy changes, objects created and destroyed during a recording, audio and generic data (a spot light), with shared sample scripts and recordable user prefabs. The networked scene requires VRSYS Core's Sample Scene Setups sample and TextMesh Pro Essential Resources.
Sample scene, input actions and prefabs showing how to set up recording and replay with VRSYS.
